scope: API execution grant dispatch and MySQL startup slice only

findings.summary: Four DDL checks render differently in real MySQL and strict initializer rejects startup.
Progress single-tenant CHECK name differs between resource and catalog; H03/H05A startup fails.
Platform admission takes Agent root then Archive manager; execution/native currently take Archive locks then Agent root.
Manager revoke then same-scope regrant can revive old active execution grants because issuance manager revision is absent.
Nonlocking lookup establishes RR snapshot before slot wait and active grant scan can miss concurrent commit.
H02 only creates content schema though importer now requires maintenance tables; production bootstrap ordering is correct.
